class.name: SpanSizeLookup
class.brief_description: Reports how many grid columns each item occupies.
class.description: SpanSizeLookup is the port of [i]GridLayoutManager.SpanSizeLookup[/i]. Subclass it and override [method _get_span_size] to let specific items span multiple columns of a [b]GridLayoutManager[/b] (for example, a full-width header). A span size of 1 means the item occupies one column; the grid clamps the result to [code][1, span_count][/code].

method.name: _get_span_size
method.description: Must override. Returns the number of grid columns the item at [code]position[/code] occupies (>= 1; values <= 0 are clamped to 1).
